title: Fourier norm of an affine-subspace indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The sum, over all frequency vectors in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, of the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients of the indicator function of the affine subspace $a+H$ is $1$.
